clips.title: Numérique : Macron appelle l'Europe à ne pas être simple "cliente" des États-Unis et de la Chine
clips.quote: Europe doesn't want to be the client of the big entrepreneurs or the big solutions being provided either from US or from China. We clearly want to design our own solutions. Not to say that we don't want to cooperate. Being more sovereign and more independent doesn't mean you want to be in autarky. No, but it means on the key pillars, on the key building blocks, you want to preserve your sovereignty.
clips.speaker: Emmanuel Macron

clips.title: Il est temps pour l’Europe d’avoir sa propre souveraineté technologique !
clips.quote: And for me now what we have to do is in in each sector in each innovation how to build the European solution and European sovereignty.
clips.speaker: Emmanuel Macron

clips.title: Il est temps pour l’Europe d’avoir sa propre souveraineté technologique !
clips.quote: Otherwise it's impossible. If I depend on the US cloud, I depend on US law and US regulation. I cannot guarantee you about the use of your data. If you want me to guarantee you about the use of your data, I need a European regulation. I have to guarantee I have for on the very critical points European devices, and I have to guarantee I have a European cloud.
clips.speaker: Emmanuel Macron

clips.title: Sommet sur la souveraineté numérique européenne à Berlin : le discours du Président Emmanuel Macron.
clips.quote: Europe doesn't want to be the client of the big entrepreneurs or the big solutions being provided either from US or from China. We clearly want to design our own solutions. Not to say that we don't want to cooperate. Being more sovereign and more independent doesn't mean you want to be in autarky. No. But it means on the key pillars, on the key building blocks, you want to preserve your sovereignty.
clips.speaker: Emmanuel Macron

clips.title: Sommet sur la souveraineté numérique européenne à Berlin : le discours du Président Emmanuel Macron.
clips.quote: And for this reason, we put digital sovereignty, fostering domestic champions and freeing ourselves from dependence on foreign technologies, as the forefront of the economic agenda that we set during the Franco-German Council of Ministers. And this summit is the time to implement this agenda and to achieve true European sovereignty, which means freeing ourselves from technological dependencies at every level of the value chain
clips.speaker: Emmanuel Macron

clips.title: Il est temps pour l’Europe d’avoir sa propre souveraineté technologique !
clips.quote: Look, by exactly such a strategy, we need European financing, European solutions, European talents, European regulation. And till now, when you look at the map, you had what we call here in Europe, the GAFA in the US, BATX in China, GDPR in Europe. So we have regulation, fair point, this is a global reference, but we don't have the equivalent of these very, very large caps.
clips.speaker: Emmanuel Macron

clips.title: Macron : "Depuis 7 ans, l’Europe a commencé à sortir de cette naïveté technologique et industrielle"
clips.quote: Le troisième pas décisif de ces dernières années, c'est que nous avons commencé à jeter les bases d'une plus grande souveraineté technologique et industrielle. Aucune zone du monde que l'Europe n'aurait accepté autant que nous de dépendre des autres sur des produits vitaux, des composantes essentielles.
clips.speaker: Emmanuel Macron
